verdict.rationale: Superset documents a local-first setup in which agents run on your own machine, and its CLI manages a 'local host server'. References to a selected host and remote workspaces suggest multi-host support, but nothing documents running in containers or on your own VMs. Missing for 10: documented container deployment, documented self-hosting on user-owned VMs or remote hosts, independent corroboration of the self-hosting setup.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can self-host agent infrastructure locally, in containers, or on my own VMs

citations.quote: Superset is local-first: it works offline and syncs when connected. Your code never leaves your machine unless you say so.
Use it to manage workspaces, tasks, automations, and the local host server from your terminal or from CI.
